import React from 'react'
import { BrowserRouter, Route, Routes } from "react-router-dom"
import ResponsiveAppBar from './components/Navbar'
import Home from './components/Home'


const App = () => {
  return (
   <>
   
    <BrowserRouter>
    
    
    <ResponsiveAppBar/>


    <Routes>

    <Route  path='/'   element={<Home/>} />


    </Routes>

    
    
    
    </BrowserRouter>
   
   
   
   </>
  )
}

export default App
